justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/build/AccessControllerPlugin.java` (lines 235-350) and `byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/build/AccessControllerPluginTest.java`. `WithProperty` is a very small nested helper: 1 field (`property`), 1 constructor, and 1 overridden method (`onAccessController`) that only emits bytecode to read a system property and parse it as a boolean. The enclosing `Initializer` already separates the alternate concern into `WithoutProperty`, so this class is narrowly focused and does not show the size, method count, or multi-responsibility indicators of insufficient modularization.
